title: AutopsyItem
description: Decision Autopsy record analysing an individual step decision vs outcome

expected.description: Expected outcome or behavior based on Laya's prediction

actual.description: Actual observed outcome from the game environment

note.description: Concise plain-English explanation framed as a testable hypothesis

severity.description: Normalized severity score from 0.0 (minor/normal) to 1.0 (critical failure)

question_id.description: The specific question whose answer was most influential

probabilities.description: Probability score for the chosen action or mapping of action probabilities
